podcast.body: This song was the Billboard year-end number one for 1967, taken from the soundtrack of the film of the same name, in which singer Lulu also starred alongside Sidney Poitier. It originally appeared as a B-side but gained popularity because DJs preferred its "wistful side" over the A-side. It topped the Hot 100 for five weeks, beating out "The Letter" and "Ode to Billie Joe." "Fortunately, DJs preferred Lulu's wistful side of the song to the A-Side and to Sir with Love topped the Hot 100 for five weeks."
